224801.name: Entrance To The Lost Crypt

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

224801.description:
An imposing archway of weathered stone frames the entrance to the lost
crypt, its keystone carved with a mournful face. Tunnels lead off east,
south and west, while a broken stair climbs up into the open gloom of a
dwarven graveyard, the way no longer barred. Fallen iron grates lie
rusted on the floor. A faint breath of outside air, carrying a hint of
cold earth, drifts down from above.

extra_descs.keystone face archway:
The keystone is carved with a weeping face, its mouth open as if in the
middle of a word. Below it, a line of dwarven runes warns the living to
turn back.

224802.name: Strange Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Lost Crypt.

224802.description:
Walls of dark stone are cut with spirals and interlocking circles that
make the eye ache to follow them. The tunnel runs east toward plainer
stone and west toward the entrance to the crypt, and a branch drops
south. The air hums faintly, as though the carvings were a single great
string plucked long ago. Your shadow stretches the wrong way across the
floor.

224803.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

224803.description:
The last of the plain ancient tunnel gives way to wall-carvings of a
stranger kind, coiling lines that seem to move at the edge of sight.
East the plain tunnel goes back, while west the strange work begins in
earnest. The floor is carpeted with crumbled plaster. Your light
flickers as if a breath had passed over it.

224804.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224804.description:
Dressed stone arches the way here in a smooth barrel vault, though the
paving underfoot has buckled and heaved. East the passage bends away and
west it goes on toward stranger carving. Pale streaks of saltpetre bloom
across the stone like frost. A cool draught slides along the floor and
sets the dust shivering.

224805.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224805.description:
The tunnel makes a rounded bend, the inner wall worn smooth by shoulders
and the outer wall rough and unfinished. North the passage runs back
along its slope, and west it carries on toward a straighter stretch. A
pile of burst sacking lies slumped at the corner, rotten to black mulch.
The smell is of cellars and old rope.

224806.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Junction.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224806.description:
A long ancient tunnel whose floor slopes faintly toward the south, so
that thin threads of water trickle along the foot of the walls. North
the way climbs back to a junction. The roof is held up by black timbers
fossilised into stone, and the walls are sooty from fires lit before any
living memory. The silence is broken only by the faint patter of
dripping.

224807.name: Three Way Junction

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

224807.description:
Three tunnels meet here beneath a roof of low arches, the stone of each
worn into a different shade of grey. North the passage bends away, east
it runs straight, and south it descends gently. A circle of black soot
on the floor shows where some forgotten band once camped. Bone splinters
lie in the ash like burnt kindling.

224808.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies T-Cross Junction.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Junction.

224808.description:
A straight length of ancient tunnel, its walls bearing a long frieze of
faded figures marching in file. The figures carry bundles and tools,
their faces blank ovals worn by countless brushing hands. The passage
runs east to a crossing and west to a junction. Cold air flows gently
along the floor.

224809.name: T-Cross Junction

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224809.description:
The passage meets a cross-wall at a T-shaped junction, and a single
squat column stands at the corner supporting the roof. The tunnel runs
south from here and returns west. The column is wrapped with chains of
rusted links, as though something once hung there. A hollow clink
answers every step you take.

224810.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies T-Cross Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Junction.

224810.description:
Ancient flagstones run between walls so close that your elbows brush the
stone. Long cracks in the ceiling show dark seams of earth above, and
thin streams of grit trickle through. The passage leads north to a
junction and south to another. The smell here is of crushed clay and
cold metal.

224811.name: Three Way Junction

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224811.description:
Three ways meet in a cramped chamber with an arched roof stained black
by smoke of ages past. A broken lantern post stands in one corner, its
iron arm snapped off. Passages lead north and east, and another runs
south into a bend. The floor is gritty with ground bone and flakes of
rust.

224812.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies T-Cross Junction.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Junction.

224812.description:
A plain stretch of tunnel, its walls closely patterned with faint
diamond carvings that catch the light like fish scales. A heap of stone
dust lies against one wall in the shape of a sleeping dog, undisturbed.
The passage runs east toward a crossing and west toward a junction. Dust
tickles the throat and a cold draught plucks at your cloak.

224813.name: T-Cross Junction

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224813.description:
A T-shaped crossing opens where a narrow stair of stone once rose to a
higher level, now just a blocked arch on the wall. Tunnels lead east,
south and back west. Old tallies are cut into the corner stone, bundles
of five strokes crossed through by dozens. A smell of damp cloth and
dead air lingers.

extra_descs.tallies strokes:
Hundreds of tally marks are cut into the corner stone, grouped in fives.
They stop abruptly in the middle of a bundle.

224814.name: Three Way Junction

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies T-Cross Junction.

224814.description:
Three tunnels converge here on a wide circular floor, in the middle of
which a round drain grate has rusted shut. A passage leads north,
another east, and the third returns west. The roof overhead is faced
with tiles of dull green, many of them fallen and shattered. The echo of
your steps takes a long moment to return.

224815.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Junction.

224815.description:
The tunnel runs level and straight between walls of fitted grey blocks,
each as long as a coffin. East the air grows busier with draughts as a
crossing draws near, and west the passage returns to a junction. A line
of rusty pegs follows the wall at shoulder height, perhaps for a rope
that has long since rotted. Your footfalls ring evenly on the stone.

224816.name: The Crossing

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Junction.

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224816.description:
Four tunnels meet at this crossing beneath a shallow dome, its centre
carved with a wheel of eight spokes. You can go north, east, south or
west from here, and each passage breathes a different cold. The floor is
worn in a cross by ages of feet, the grooves deep enough to catch a
boot. Dust lies in drifts in the corners like fallen snow.

224817.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Crossing.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224817.description:
The tunnel stretches between the crossing and a bend, its walls streaked
with trails of white mineral from a thousand seepings. North lies the
crossing, and south the passage drifts toward a corner. The floor is
ridged with the ghost of old cart ruts, cut deep in the stone. A cool
damp wind brings the scent of bruised earth.

224818.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224818.description:
A sharp corner turns the tunnel from its straight course, and the outer
wall bulges as if pushed by the weight of the earth behind. The way
north returns toward the crossing and east leads on around the bend. A
hand-sized hole in the wall shows only blackness. Grit drizzles down
from a crack above and patters on the stone.

224819.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224819.description:
The passage bends again, and the ceiling here is plastered with a fading
mural of a long procession passing beneath stars. Most of the colour has
flaked and fallen to the floor as a gritty blue dust. South the way
carries on, and west it runs back toward the previous corner. The air is
thin and has a taste of dried herbs.

224820.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224820.description:
Another bend, this one narrow enough that your pack scrapes the wall.
Rough steps in the floor mark a slight descent, and the stones are worn
glassy from use. North the passage returns up the bend, and west it runs
on into straight tunnel. A pair of iron staples set in the wall once
held a gate or a chain. Now they hold nothing but rust.

224821.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Tunnel.

224821.description:
Straight ancient tunnel, its roof supported by a row of heavy ribs of
dark stone. Between the ribs the ceiling is plastered with soot, and in
places strange symbols have been scorched into it. The way east returns
to a bend, and the tunnel carries on west. A faint smell of burnt hair
clings to the stone.

224822.name: Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

224822.description:
A long, dull stretch of tunnel with nothing to mark one pace from
another but the thin crust of bones along the base of the walls. They
are laid side by side, as if tidied. The passage leads east and west,
equally dark. A cold current slips along the floor and fingers its way
into your boots.

224823.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End.

224823.description:
The tunnel bends south at a corner of heavy blocks, and the air grows
suddenly hot and fetid. Deep gouges mark the floor and walls as if great
claws scraped for purchase. East the way returns along the straight
tunnel, and south lies a blind end. A sound like the slow grinding of
stones comes from somewhere ahead.

224824.name: A Dead End

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Bone Gnasher's Lair.

224824.description:
A short dead-end vestibule faces a massive door of black iron set in the
southern wall. Its surface is battered and dented, and the lock plate
hangs by a single bolt. The only other way is north, back along the
tunnel. Bone shards and torn scraps of leather are heaped before the
door, trodden into the floor by heavy feet.

extra_descs.door black iron:
The black iron door is dented from the inside and the outside alike.
Scratches run across it at the height of a standing man's head, and
higher still.

224825.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Junction.

224825.description:
The tunnel narrows and begins to twist, its walls scored with the claw-
marks of something that dragged itself along the stone. North it winds
into an unsettling tangle, and south it returns to the junction. The
floor is smeared with dark stains long dried to brown. Cold, stale air
carries a sourness like old fat.

224826.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

224826.description:
A bewildering tangle of low stone corridors, doubling back through
arches so alike that each seems the mirror of the last. Moisture beads
the walls and runs in thin lines to the floor. The air is flat and
heavy, stifling every sound. You glimpse a grey blur of movement at the
edge of your light, but it is only your own shadow.

224827.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

224827.description:
Passages of rough stone twist around you in a knot that no mapmaker
could draw. The roof presses low, and the walls glisten with a thin film
of damp that reflects your light in distorted ribbons. Faint knocking
comes from within the rock, steady as a slow heartbeat. After a dozen
turns you cannot tell where you entered.

224828.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

224828.description:
The maze of passages here is carpeted with scraps of bone and brittle
cloth, ankle deep in places. Alcoves cut into the walls hold only dust
and faint outlines where something once rested. Every tunnel is crooked,
tilted at an angle that makes your stomach lurch. The dark swallows any
light you carry before it reaches the walls.

224829.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

224829.description:
Round after round of narrow tunnel curls through this knot of crypt,
ending where it began. Thin red lines of paint trail along the wall,
perhaps once a guide and now a lure to nowhere. The chill is bone-deep
and the quiet seems to listen. Once a footstep sounds behind you, but it
was your own echo.

24830.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24830.description:
The passage bends and doubles back so often that every few steps feel
like the ones before. Grey bone dust lies thick on the flagstones,
scuffed by feet that went round and round. Scratched arrows in the wall
point three different ways, and none of them agree. The air is dead and
cold, and your own breathing returns to you from places that are not
there.

24831.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24831.description:
Low arches of fitted stone close in overhead, and the walls bear row
upon row of empty burial niches stuffed with nothing but dust. A faint
draught seems to come from every side at once. Someone once chalked a
spiral on the floor, now half worn away by countless wanderers. You
cannot tell whether you have come this way before.

24832.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24832.description:
Splintered ribs and a cracked pelvis crunch underfoot as you edge along
a tunnel too narrow for two to pass. The walls sweat with cold damp, and
green mould streaks the stone where old torches once smoked. The
turnings come and go so quickly that your sense of the way slips from
you. A single iron ring hangs from the ceiling, rusted solid, with no
purpose you can guess.

24833.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24833.description:
A dripping silence fills this stretch of the maze, broken only by water
ticking onto stone somewhere out of sight. The floor is paved in worn
slabs carved with faded names that no living person could read. Three
low openings gape in the walls, and each leads into the same grey gloom.
You taste old earth and cold ash on the air.

24834.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24834.description:
The tunnel narrows to a crawl where the ceiling sags on cracked beams of
blackened oak. Skulls grin from a shelf cut into the wall, their jaws
wedged open with fallen grit. A smear of old soot trails along the stone
as though some traveller dragged a torch to mark a way and then gave up.
Every turning looks like the one you just left.

24835.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24835.description:
The walls are carved with shallow grooves that run in loops and knots
and finish nowhere at all. A heap of tumbled stones half blocks the
passage, forcing you to squeeze through a gap scraped smooth by earlier
hands. The cold is bitter, and the dark presses close around any light
you carry. Far off a slow dull echo rolls and fades into nothing.

24836.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24836.description:
A cracked stone lid leans against the wall beside an empty bier, its
carving of a robed figure worn to a smooth blur. The dust here is deep
and unmarked except for a single line of old prints that circles back on
itself. Mouldering cloth hangs in the corners like cobwebs. The passage
seems to lengthen the harder you walk.

24837.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24837.description:
Black water seeps down the walls and gathers in a shallow trough along
the base, smelling of iron and rot. Pale roots from far above have
pushed through the vault and hang in ghostly tangles. The corridor
splits and rejoins itself so many times that it seems to fold into the
dark. An iron bracket on the wall still holds the ghost of a lamp, black
with ancient soot.

24838.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

east.description: To the east lies Hidden Tomb.

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24838.description:
The tangle of passages loosens at last, and a narrow arch opens east
onto a hidden tomb. Dust hangs in thin curtains, stirred by a draught
that slips through the arch. The walls are scratched with a mad scatter
of marks, some of them pointing the wrong way on purpose. Bones lie
crushed along the floor where earlier searchers turned back.

24839.name: Hidden Tomb

east.description: To the east lies Hidden Tomb.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24839.description:
A low vaulted chamber of grey stone, its walls cut with tiers of burial
shelves where shrouded shapes lie long dead. The tomb runs on east into
a deeper vault, and the way west leads back into the twisting tunnels.
The air is thick with the sweetness of incense gone sour. Cobwebs hang
heavy from the ribs of the ceiling.

24840.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24840.description:
The walls here are lined with shelves of yellowed skulls, set in neat
rows by some tidy hand long ago. Between the shelves the passage kinks
left and right and left again until the way behind you is lost. A cold
trickle of air stirs the dust into slow spirals. You notice that your
own footprints seem to lead the wrong way.

24841.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24841.description:
A fine grey ash covers the floor like old snow, unmarked and soft under
the boot. The ceiling is so low that you stoop, brushing hanging strings
of root and cobweb. Faded handprints in red ochre climb the wall in
pairs, as if mourners pressed their palms to the stone for luck. The
tunnel seems to curve gently in a circle without end.

24842.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24842.description:
Cracked flagstones rock under your weight, and each step sets off a dry
echo that returns from the wrong direction. Tarnished bronze plaques are
bolted along the wall, their inscriptions rubbed smooth by the damp. A
bitter smell of lamp oil and mildew hangs in the air. The corridor turns
upon itself like a coiled snake.

24843.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24843.description:
Water has worked its way through the rock here, leaving the walls glazed
with a slick brown film and the floor patched with puddles of oily
black. Bones lie in the shallows, stained the colour of tea. The tunnel
narrows and widens without reason, and every opening resembles the last.
A cold dripping noise follows you wherever you turn.

24844.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24844.description:
Chunks of fallen masonry choke the way, forcing you to climb over one
pile and slide down another. Sooty handprints streak the ceiling where
earlier travellers steadied themselves in the dark. A sour taste of iron
lingers in your mouth. This stretch of the maze feels older than the
rest, the stone worn to a glassy sheen.

24845.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24845.description:
A crooked pillar of fused bone stands in the middle of the passage, as
though a charnel heap had been cemented with lime. The walls are
plastered with old burial notices, flaking and illegible. You pass the
pillar and find another beyond it, and then another, each exactly alike.
The air is heavy with chalk and cold.

24846.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24846.description:
The tunnel floor is paved with tombstones laid flat, their names worn
nearly away by passing feet. Slow cold drops fall from the ceiling in an
uneven rhythm, ringing on the stones. The walls curve inward like the
inside of a great urn. Somewhere ahead a faint scraping sound stops
whenever you stop.

24847.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24847.description:
Rough-cut stairs lead up a few steps, then down a few steps, and finish
where they began. Rusted nails jut from the walls where burial shrouds
once hung, and a few threads of grey cloth still cling to them. The
place smells of cold mud and crushed lilies. It is impossible to say
whether you are going anywhere.

24848.name: Tunnel Of Confusion

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

north.description: To the north lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

24848.description:
The maze thins out at last into a bare shaft of dressed stone, where a
narrow stairway plunges steeply down. Chisel marks cover the walls in
neat, tireless rows. The draught that flows from below is warmer than
the tunnels, and tastes faintly of sulphur. Dust on the lip of the first
step shows many feet have gone down and few have returned.

24849.name: A Dead End

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

north.description: To the north lies At The Narrow Stairway.

west.description: To the west lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24849.description:
The tunnel ends abruptly at a blank wall of fitted stone, its mortar
still crisp as if the builders had only just gone. Bone scatters the
floor in a ragged fan where wanderers fell and were not found. A
scratched message in the wall says only that there is nothing here. The
way back leads south.

24850.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dead End.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

24850.description:
The ancient tunnel bends at a blunt corner, where the ceiling dips so
low that a tall traveller must duck. A cracked wall of great square
blocks runs along the outer edge, scored with the marks of old picks.
The passage leads north to a dead end and east around the corner. A damp
coldness clings to every surface.

24851.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Junction.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

24851.description:
A second bend turns the tunnel sharply, and the stones underfoot change
from rough cobbles to worn square flags. Streaks of green stain the wall
where water has run for ages. The way west returns around the corner,
and south the passage reaches a junction. A tiny trickle runs along the
floor and vanishes into a crack.

24853.name: A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Junction.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

24853.description:
A bend in the tunnel where roots from far above have forced through the
ceiling and hang in pale, dead curtains. North the passage runs back
toward a junction, and west it ends in a small dead end. The floor is
damp with seepage and dotted with fallen pebbles. The scent of wet earth
is strong here.

24854.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Ancient Tunnel.

24854.description:
A cramped pocket of a dead end, barely wider than a man's reach, its
walls veined with glittering flecks of pyrite. Someone has wedged a bone
into a crack in the end wall, perhaps as a charm. The way back leads
east. A thin layer of dust has settled here that nothing has disturbed
for years.

24855.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies T-Cross Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Tunnel.

24855.description:
A narrow tunnel of rough hewn stone runs away from the junction, the
ceiling dropping lower with each step. The way north returns toward the
crossing of passages, and south the tunnel goes on into dark. The floor
is a gritty mix of earth and splintered bone. A long, dry scrape sounds
somewhere ahead, then ceases.

24856.name: Ancient Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Tunnel.

24856.description:
The tunnel ends in a rounded niche, as if the builders had begun a
chamber and abandoned it. Faint marks of chisels cover the end wall, and
heaps of rubble lie where the work was left. The tunnel can be left only
by going back north. The stillness is complete, and your own heartbeat
sounds loud in your ears.

24857.name: Void Of Sunlight

north.description: To the north lies Around The Lost Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Hidden Cave.

24857.description:
No glimmer of day has ever touched this place, and the dark is so
complete that it seems to have weight. Your footsteps thud softly on a
floor of packed bone meal and grit. The walls are rough rock slick with
cold sweat, and the passage leads on north toward the rim of the lost
cave. The silence presses on your ears.

24858.name: Bone Gnasher's Lair

north.description: To the north lies A Dead End.

down.description: To the down lies Demlag's Hidden Treasury Cave.

24858.description:
A vast, reeking chamber hacked out of the crypt rock, its floor ankle
deep in splintered bone. Great ribs and jawbones have been dragged
together in a nest against the far wall, and the stone is blackened with
old fires. The door north leads back into the tunnels, while a ragged
hole in the floor drops to a cave below. Everything here has been
gnawed, and the air is thick with the heat of a living beast.

24859.name: Three Way Junction

north.description: To the north lies A Dead End.

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Junction.

south.description: To the south lies The Crossing.

24859.description:
A junction where the passage splits three ways beneath a ceiling stained
with long ribbons of damp. North a short tunnel ends in shadow, east it
curves toward another meeting, and south it returns to the crossing. A
scatter of cracked jars lies against the wall, all of them stopped with
moulded wax. The air smells of tallow and cold ash.

24860.name: A Dead End

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Junction.

24860.description:
A small blind chamber where the tunnel stops against a face of unbroken
rock. Someone has scratched a map on the wall, a tangle of lines that
leads back on itself and ends in a crude skull. The way back is south.
Bones from some larger beast lie heaped against the end wall, gnawed
white and split for the marrow.

24861.name: Three Way Junction

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Junction.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Junction.

24861.description:
The tunnel turns here at a corner, where a stout post of black wood once
supported the ceiling and now leans against it, split and sagging. South
the passage runs on to another meeting, and west it returns to the first
junction. Cold water collects in the hollows of the floor. A cluster of
pale growths clings to the leaning post, glistening faintly.

24862.name: Three Way Junction

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Junction.

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End.

west.description: To the west lies The Crossing.

24862.description:
Three passages gather here, their mouths low and round like the throats
of old drains. North and west lead back toward other junctions, while
south the tunnel finishes in a dead end. The floor is scattered with the
dry remains of rushes, and a row of sooty niches lines the wall. A dull,
constant drip echoes from the farthest of the openings.

24863.name: A Dead End

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Junction.

24863.description:
A rounded dead end where the tunnel narrows to a wedge and stops at a
plug of earth and stone. The ceiling bows overhead as if the rock itself
had wearied of holding up. The only way out is back north. Broken
pottery litters the floor, and the dust is heavy with the rank smell of
an animal's lair.

24864.name: Hidden Tomb

east.description: To the east lies Hidden Tomb.

west.description: To the west lies Hidden Tomb.

24864.description:
A heavy door of iron-banded oak stands open in the eastern wall, its
hinges furred with rust but still willing to turn. Beyond it the tomb
goes on, while the way west returns to the first vault. Stone coffins
line the walls in stacked rows, their lids carved with weathered faces.
A chill rolls off the stone, and the floor is gritty with powdered bone.

24865.name: Hidden Tomb

east.description: To the east lies T-Cross Junction.

west.description: To the west lies Hidden Tomb.

24865.description:
The tomb ends at a wide threshold of cracked tiles, where a mosaic of a
crowned skeleton has mostly fallen to rubble. The door you came through
stands to the west, and east the vault gives way to a crossing of
passages. Rows of small sealed urns sit in wall niches, their wax seals
gone brittle. The silence is deep enough to hear dust settle.

24866.name: T-Cross Junction

north.description: To the north lies Hidden Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Hidden Tomb.

west.description: To the west lies Hidden Tomb.

24866.description:
Three passages meet at a squared junction of dressed stone, its corners
rubbed smooth by ages of passing hands. West runs back to the tomb
vaults, south drops to another burial chamber, and a rough opening north
breathes damp, cavelike air. A cracked pillar stands at the centre,
carved with a ring of stylised skulls. Bone shards glitter in the dust
like spilled coins.

extra_descs.pillar skulls:
The cracked pillar is carved with a ring of grinning skulls, each with a
different expression, as if the mason mocked the dead one by one.

24867.name: Hidden Tomb

north.description: To the north lies T-Cross Junction.

south.description: To the south lies Hidden Tomb.

24867.description:
A narrow tomb chamber, its walls honeycombed with burial niches no wider
than a man's shoulders. The way north leads back to the junction, and
the tomb goes on south. Faded paint on the lintels shows the names of a
forgotten family, each crossed through with a harsh stroke. The floor is
littered with the dry husks of funeral flowers.

24868.name: Hidden Tomb

north.description: To the north lies Hidden Tomb.

down.description: To the down lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24868.description:
A round shaft opens in the floor of this small burial chamber, and a
stair of worn steps winds down into it. The way north returns to the
first tomb. Dark stains streak the stone around the shaft where
something heavy was once dragged to the edge. A smell of deep earth and
stale air climbs from below.

24870.name: Strange Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Lost Crypt.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

north.description: To the north lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24870.description:
The strange tunnel narrows here into a crooked gallery, the walls
leaning together overhead like folded hands. East lies the entrance
arch, south the passage drops toward a junction, and west it carries on.
Small shelves hold broken lamps and shards of glass. A scent of old
incense hangs motionless in the air.

24871.name: Strange Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

24871.description:
A small, tight corner where two strange tunnels meet at a sharp angle.
East the way leads to a crooked gallery and south it runs to the long
vault. The walls here are scribbled with thousands of tiny tally marks
in dried brown paint. A thick, old cold seems to rise from the very
stone.

24872.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel Of Living Dead.

24872.description:
The strange tunnel opens into a long vault where rows of broken pillars
march into the gloom, and the way west is open and unbarred, leading
toward the Tunnel Of Living Dead. Other passages lead north, east and
south. A low moaning wind comes up the open way, smelling of grave-
mould. Shattered lamps and bent chain-links litter the floor.

24873.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies A Secret Treasury Room.

24873.description:
A great cross-shaped meeting of strange tunnels, its floor a mosaic of
cracked tiles in muddy colours. Tunnels lead off on all four sides, and
a trapdoor of iron bars opens in the floor, with a ladder of rusted
rungs dropping into a hidden room below. The ceiling bears a painted
sun, long faded to a grey disc. Heavy dust hangs in the air.

extra_descs.trapdoor ladder:
A trapdoor of iron bars is set in the floor, hinged open, with a ladder
of rusted rungs leading down into the dark.

24874.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Lost Crypt.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

24874.description:
Four tunnels meet in a small round room, its walls slashed with deep
parallel grooves like the marks of a great rake. A way leads north
toward the crypt entrance, east and south further into the strange
tunnels, and west to a deeper junction. The floor is cluttered with old
bone, brittle as chalk. A sweet, sickly smell clings to the air.

24875.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

24875.description:
A strange tunnel whose ceiling slants one way and whose floor slants the
other, so that the passage seems to twist like a wrung cloth. North lies
the junction of the carved ways, south the tunnel winds on, and west a
side passage leads off. Grooves in the wall are filled with a dull
silver metal that has tarnished to black. The air is tinged with ozone.

24876.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

24876.description:
The passage here is a tight elbow, as if two tunnels dug from opposite
ends had met by chance and been joined. North the way returns toward the
junction and west it goes on. Beads of cold water stand on the walls in
perfect rows. Bone chips lie among the grit, pale as seeds.

24877.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

24877.description:
A strange junction where three tunnels meet at odd angles beneath a
ceiling carved with a ring of blank-faced masks. North, east and west
each lead off into the dimness. A fine sand covers the floor, and
runnels in it show where a sluggish draught flows. One mask has fallen
and lies in pieces, its stone eyes still staring upward.

24878.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Strange Tunnel.

24878.description:
A twisting stretch of strange tunnel, the walls pocked with small round
holes as though pierced by worms. North the way returns to the great
crossing, east it joins another junction, and west it runs to a corner.
Mounds of grey powder lie under each hole. The air is dry, and carries a
faint odour of vinegar.

24879.name: Strange Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Strange Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Strange Tunnel.

24879.description:
A short corner of the strange tunnel, walled with huge stones fitted
without mortar and polished to a dull gleam. North the passage rises to
a junction and east it runs on. A frieze of crawling beetles encircles
the stone just above head height. Beneath your feet the floor sounds
oddly hollow.

24880.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

east.description: To the east lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

up.description: To the up lies Hidden Tomb.

24880.description:
The stair ends in a wide gallery of black stone that curves around some
great hidden bulk. Burial niches pierce the outer wall in rows, and
every one is plugged with a carved slab. The gallery leads on east, and
the stair climbs back up to the hidden tomb. The cold here is the cold
of a place sealed for centuries.

24881.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

east.description: To the east lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24881.description:
The gallery runs straight between a curved inner wall of massive blocks
and a rank of sealed niches. Seams in the blocks are packed with lead,
and a pattern of runes has been hammered over them. The way goes on
east, and west returns to the foot of the stair. A scatter of broken
seals crunches underfoot.

24882.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

south.description: To the south lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24882.description:
The gallery bends sharply here, following the curve of the sealed crypt
it surrounds. Frescoes along the inner wall show a procession of hooded
mourners, flaking away in grey scales. The path leads on south, and west
returns along the gallery. Soot from long-dead lamps blackens the
ceiling in thick streaks.

24883.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

north.description: To the north lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

south.description: To the south lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24883.description:
A long, cold run of gallery stretches between north and south, its floor
worn into a shallow trough by ancient processions. Hooks in the wall
once held banners, and only rags of dark cloth remain. Stone angels with
chipped faces guard the niches, their wings folded tight. A faint dry
rattle sounds from deep inside the walls.

24884.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

north.description: To the north lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24884.description:
The gallery turns again at a corner where the vault drops lower and the
blocks of the inner wall are scarred with deep gouges. The way north
runs back along the gallery and the way west carries on around. Long
scrapes mark the floor as if some great weight was hauled across. The
air smells of tar and old iron.

24885.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

east.description: To the east lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24885.description:
A straight length of the gallery, its ceiling held up by squat pillars
carved to resemble stacked skulls. Between the pillars stand empty stone
benches where mourners once sat vigil. The gallery leads on west, and
east returns toward the corner. Frost forms in a thin crust on the
benches despite no wind.

24886.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

north.description: To the north lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

east.description: To the east lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24886.description:
The gallery meets a wall of heaped rubble where part of the roof has
come down, leaving a gap barely wide enough to climb. North the way
continues over the fallen stones, while east returns along the gallery.
Splinters of carved lintel lie among the debris, still bearing traces of
gilt. Fine dust drifts down from the ceiling with every footstep.

24887.name: Around The Sealed Crypt

east.description: To the east lies Above The Sealed Crypt.

south.description: To the south lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

24887.description:
A short, high-roofed passage where the gallery rises toward a gate set
in the inner wall. The gate is a great slab of bronze green with age,
its handles melted into lumps. The way east leads on toward a stair, and
south returns down the gallery. Crude warnings are scratched into the
stone around it, long since worn faint.

extra_descs.gate bronze warnings:
The warnings are in an old script, scratched over and over by many
hands. The few words you can make out say only that the dead are not to
be woken.

24888.name: Above The Sealed Crypt

west.description: To the west lies Around The Sealed Crypt.

down.description: To the down lies Estorgoth's Den.

24888.description:
A round chamber stands above the sealed crypt, its floor a wheel of
black and white tiles around a dark opening. The way west returns to the
gallery, and a ramp of rough steps leads down into a den. A hot rank
stench rises from below, wholly at odds with the tomb's cold. Bones have
been piled against the walls in careless drifts.

24889.name: Hidden Cave

north.description: To the north lies Void Of Sunlight.

south.description: To the south lies T-Cross Junction.

24889.description:
Here the dressed stone gives out and the tunnel opens into a natural
cave of dripping limestone. Pale mineral curtains hang from the roof,
and the floor is a slope of broken rock and old bones. The passage goes
on north into deeper dark. The air is damp and utterly still, with no
hint of sky.

24890.name: Around The Lost Cave

east.description: To the east lies Around The Lost Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Void Of Sunlight.

24890.description:
A ledge of broken rock skirts the edge of a great cavern that falls away
into blackness. A narrow path leads on east along the rim, hemmed in by
a wall of dripping stone. Cold air rises from the depths carrying a
smell of wet clay and old death. Loose pebbles skitter from your feet
and tick down into the void for a long time.

24891.name: Around The Lost Cave

east.description: To the east lies Around The Lost Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Lost Cave.

24891.description:
The path widens into a shelf strewn with bleached ribs and the
splintered handles of ancient tools. Flowstone has crusted one side of
the wall in rippling folds of cream and rust. The ledge leads on east
and back west, with the gulf of the cavern yawning beside it. A steady
drip counts the seconds from somewhere overhead.

24892.name: Around The Lost Cave

north.description: To the north lies Around The Lost Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Lost Cave.

24892.description:
The ledge turns sharply here, climbing north over a hump of fallen
boulders while the way west returns along the rim. Fine black droppings
carpet the stone, and the roof above is lost in shadow. The cavern
echoes with a faint whisper, like wind in a hollow throat. Every
handhold is slick and cold.

24893.name: Around The Lost Cave

north.description: To the north lies Around The Lost Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Around The Lost Cave.

24893.description:
A straight stretch of path runs between the cavern wall and a sheer
drop, narrow enough that you must keep a hand on the rock. Veins of pale
crystal glitter where they cross the wall. The ledge leads on north and
returns south. Far below, water gurgles in the unseen deep.

24894.name: Around The Lost Cave

south.description: To the south lies Around The Lost Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Around The Lost Cave.

24894.description:
The path bends around a great pillar of stone where roof and floor have
long since joined. Thick stalagmites crowd the floor like broken teeth,
and you must pick a way between them. The ledge returns south and
carries on west around the rim. A thin chalky dust coats everything and
muffles every sound.

24895.name: Around The Lost Cave

east.description: To the east lies Around The Lost Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Around The Lost Cave.

24895.description:
The ledge dips past a shallow pool, its surface so still that it holds
the reflection of every stalactite overhead. The path runs east back
along the rim and south toward the cave mouth. The rock underfoot is
slippery with pale slime. Somewhere a single drop falls and rings like a
distant bell.

24896.name: Around The Lost Cave

north.description: To the north lies Around The Lost Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Lost Cave.

24896.description:
The rim path rises to a low shelf of rock where the cavern narrows
toward a mouth in the wall to the west. Scratches and soot marks show
where many hands have steadied themselves on the climb. The path runs
north back along the rim. A cold breath of air flows from the opening.

24897.name: Entrance To The Lost Cave

north.description: To the north lies The Lost Cave.

east.description: To the east lies Around The Lost Cave.

24897.description:
A rough gateway of fallen rocks marks the way into the lost cave, which
opens north in a vast hollow. Old torches have burned to black stumps in
iron sconces hammered into the rock. The path east follows the cavern
rim. Fragments of pottery crunch underfoot, offerings left by those long
dead.

24898.name: The Lost Cave

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Lost Cave.

24898.description:
The lost cave is a cavern so wide that your light cannot find its far
walls. Stalactites hang in dense ranks from the roof, dripping onto
stalagmites that rise like pale candles. The floor is a hummock of bone
and clay, and at the centre a ring of blackened stones marks a long-dead
fire. The only way out is south toward the entrance.

24899.name: Estorgoth's Den

up.description: To the up lies Above The Sealed Crypt.

24899.description:
A low cave den has been gnawed out of the old tomb foundations, its
walls scored by claws and its roof black with smoke. A bed of tangled
hides and shattered bones fills one corner, ankle deep. The ramp climbs
up to the chamber above, the only way in or out. The reek of rot is
overwhelming, and the dark here seems to breathe.

24940.name: Demlag's Hidden Treasury Cave

up.description: To the up lies Bone Gnasher's Lair.

24940.description:
A small cave lies hidden beneath the lair, its roof so low that you must
stoop to move. Chipped coins and bent trinkets glint in the crevices,
flung there by a hoarding hand. A rope of knotted hide hangs from the
hole above, and the climb up leads back into the lair. The air is dry
and still, and tastes of copper.

24957.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies Tunnel Of Confusion.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24957.description:
The stair is barely wider than your shoulders, cut into the rock in
tight, steep steps worn hollow in the middle. A rope handrail of black
twisted fibre runs along the wall, stiff with age. Up the shaft the maze
waits, and the stair drops on into the dark. Each step breathes out a
cold, mineral smell.

24958.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24958.description:
The stairs here curve in a gentle spiral, the wall on one side blank and
the other open to a sheer fall that swallows your light. Small niches
hold the stubs of candles melted into puddles of grey wax. The steps
lead up and down, equally lost in shadow. Water drips somewhere far
below with a faint, patient sound.

24959.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24959.description:
A narrow landing interrupts the stair, its floor worn into a shallow
dish by the feet of countless descents. On the wall a carved relief
shows a line of figures walking down, their heads bowed, and the last of
them has no face. The stair goes on up and down from here. The air is
thick with the tang of cold iron.

extra_descs.relief figures:
The relief shows a long line of cloaked figures descending a stair,
heads bowed. The last figure in the line has been chiselled out, leaving
only a smooth scar in the stone.

24960.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End.

24960.description:
Steps fall away steeply here, their edges chipped and rounded as though
by great age and little care. Pale threads of fungus grow in the cracks,
glowing faintly where light touches them. You can climb up the way you
came or continue down into deeper cold. The walls lean close enough to
brush both your shoulders.

24961.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24961.description:
A crack in the wall releases a thin hiss of foul air that stirs the dust
along the stairway. The steps are slick with a dark film, and your boots
grip poorly. Faded paint on the stone shows a skeletal hand, its finger
pointing down. The stair continues down into blackness, and up toward
the maze.

24962.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

24962.description:
The stair widens for a few paces into a shallow terrace, and a stone
bench rests against the wall, worn smooth by weary sitters. A bronze
lamp-bracket hangs above it, long empty of oil and green with age.
Beyond the terrace the steps carry on down, and up leads back toward the
maze. The silence has a thickness, as if the stone were listening.

24963.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Narrow Stairway.

east.description: To the east lies A Dead End.

24963.description:
Here the stairway is cut through a vein of dark glassy rock, and your
light shatters into a hundred tiny reflections along the walls. The
steps are sharp and uneven, and the air tastes of burnt flint. The way
climbs up behind you and plunges down ahead. A low moan of wind rises
from the depths and dies away.

24964.name: At The Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies At The Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies End Of The Narrow Stairway.

south.description: To the south lies Strange Tunnel.

24964.description:
At the foot of the stairway the steps end at a broad gap where a barred
gate once stood, its iron torn away and bent flat against the wall. The
way down is open now, and a deeper crypt waits beyond in the dark. The
stairs climb up behind you. Warm foul air flows out of the gap and
carries the sound of distant dragging.

24998.name: A Secret Treasury Room

up.description: To the up lies Strange Tunnel.

24998.description:
A secret room of dark granite lies hidden below the tunnel, its walls
inlaid with pale veins of marble. The only way out is the ladder up to
the great crossing. Empty plinths line the walls, and the floor is
crossed with scratches where heavy chests were dragged away. The air is
cold and stale, and the dust here has never been disturbed by wind.

650500.name: skeleton tomb guardian bones
650500.long_desc: A tomb skeleton clatters about, its jaw hanging loose and its empty sockets turned toward you.
650500.description:
Yellowed bones are bound together by nothing but dark purpose. It
carries a rusted blade in a hand of knuckle and wire, and it moves with
the stiff patience of the long dead.

650501.name: ghoul crypt corpse
650501.long_desc: A gaunt crypt ghoul crouches over a heap of bones, gnawing with dull teeth.
650501.description:
Grey skin is stretched taut over its ribs, and its fingers end in
cracked black claws. The ghoul's eyes burn with a sickly hunger, and a
rank smell of the grave rolls off it.

650502.name: spider cave giant
650502.long_desc: A pale cave spider hangs from the rock overhead, its legs twitching.
650502.description:
Bloated and the colour of old bone, this spider is as big as a hound.
Its eyes are milky pits and its fangs glisten with a clear venom.

650503.name: cultist grave robed
650503.long_desc: A hooded grave cultist mutters over a string of knucklebones.
650503.description:
A gaunt figure in a soot-grey robe, his face daubed with white chalk
like a skull. A bone-handled knife hangs from his belt, and his lips
move without ceasing in a prayer to something long buried.

650504.name: skeleton armoured warden knight
650504.long_desc: An armoured skeleton stands rigid in rusted plate, a notched greatsword at its side.
650504.description:
Black iron plates, pitted and green at the seams, still hang on the
skeleton's frame, and a crest of a long-dead house marks its breast. It
stands guard with terrible patience, and the bones inside the armour
creak when it moves.

650505.name: ghost crypt pale spirit
650505.long_desc: A wailing crypt ghost drifts through the wall, its pale face twisted in grief.
650505.description:
The ghost is a smoke-grey shape in the form of a woman, her hair
streaming upward as if in a gale. Her mouth gapes in a silent scream,
and where she passes the cold deepens.

650506.name: estorgoth ogre brute denlord
650506.long_desc: Estorgoth the den-ogre squats on his heap of hides, rocking a gnawed thighbone in his fist.
650506.description:
Estorgoth is a mountain of grey scarred muscle, his head crowned with a
rough helm of skull-plates. His small red eyes watch every move you
make, and his jaw is smeared with old gore. He is jealous of every bone
in the crypt.

650507.name: bone gnasher troll boss
650507.long_desc: Bone Gnasher, a huge hunched troll, squats in the filth of his lair, cracking a thighbone between his teeth.
650507.description:
Bone Gnasher stands half again the height of a man, a warty hulk of
green-grey hide with long arms that scrape the floor. His teeth are
broken yellow tusks, and every bone he cracks he sucks dry of marrow. A
great maul made of a knotted femur hangs from his belt.

750500.name: sword grave rusted blade
750500.room_desc: A rusted grave sword lies here.
750500.description: A broad blade pitted by centuries in the tomb, but its edge has been honed to bite. The hilt is bound with a strip of dead leather.

750501.name: ring bone carved
750501.room_desc: A carved bone ring lies here.
750501.description: A ring cut from the knuckle of some old saint and carved with tiny sigils. It is cold to the touch and strangely heavy.

750502.name: helm warden iron pitted
750502.room_desc: A pitted warden's helm lies here.
750502.description: A great iron helm with a narrow eye-slit, green at the seams but sound. A crest of a forgotten house is raised on its brow.

750503.name: cloak hide estorgoth thick
750503.room_desc: A reeking hide cloak lies here.
750503.description: Many hides have been stitched together into a stiff, heavy cloak that smells of the den. It turns a blade better than it looks.

750504.name: maul femur bone gnasher
750504.room_desc: A huge femur maul lies here.
750504.description: A great thighbone bound in iron bands and hung with grisly trophies. Its weight is more than most hands can lift, but it strikes with terrible force.
